title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
title_zh: Hierarchical Memory Mamba：解决长序列建模中的表示瓶颈
abstract_en: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory embedded in the backbone's hidden states. The PLS is subsequently compressed into persistent long-term memory for task-relevant retrieval. The hierarchical processing of semantic information overcomes the representation bottleneck of RLAs and endows HMM cross-task generalization through parametric learning, which is not observed in other long-context enhanced Mamba variants. Evaluations on Passkey Retrieval and LongBench-E tasks demonstrate that HMM improves retrieval success by 34.3--37.1% and reasoning accuracy by 1.6--14.2% over strong Mamba-based models, while adding only 2% extra parameters and with minimal training overhead.
abstract_zh: 递归线性注意力模型（Recurrent Linear Attention, RLA）如 Mamba 以线性时间复杂度提供了 Transformer 的高效替代方案，但其固定容量的递归状态限制了长序列建模能力。受人类层级记忆机制启发，本文提出 Hierarchical Memory Mamba（HMM）。HMM 基于预训练 Mamba 主干，引入轻量级工作记忆模块，从主干隐藏状态中的快速感知记忆里提取较慢变化的段落级语义（Paragraph-Level Semantics, PLS），再将 PLS 压缩为持久长期记忆，用于任务相关检索。通过对语义信息进行层级处理，HMM 缓解了 RLA 的表示瓶颈，并通过参数化学习获得跨任务泛化能力，这是其他长上下文增强型 Mamba 变体中未观察到的。实验表明，在 Passkey Retrieval 和 LongBench-E 上，HMM 相比强 Mamba-based 模型将检索成功率提升 34.3–37.1%，推理准确率提升 1.6–14.2%，同时仅增加约 2% 参数量，训练开销很小。
key_points_zh: 提出 Hierarchical Memory Mamba（HMM），在预训练 Mamba 主干上加入轻量级工作记忆与长期记忆机制。
通过从隐藏状态中抽取段落级语义（PLS）并压缩存储，缓解 RLA 固定递归状态带来的长序列表示瓶颈。
HMM 的层级语义处理带来跨任务泛化能力，区别于其他仅针对长上下文增强的 Mamba 变体。
在 Passkey Retrieval 上检索成功率提升 34.3–37.1%，在 LongBench-E 上推理准确率提升 1.6–14.2%。
额外参数量仅约 2%，训练开销较低，具备较好的效率与可扩展性。

llm_assessment.comment: This is mainly a long-sequence model architecture paper and has little direct relevance to agent harnesses, trajectories, evaluation, or operations.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这主要是一篇长序列模型架构论文，与智能体 harness、轨迹、评测或运维的直接关系很弱。
